description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experience evidence, Express Entry file and evidence review, in-Canada PR-card/residency source navigation, BOWP-in-Canada source navigation, standalone procedural-fairness-letter concerns, or LMIA-exempt employer hiring through the International Mobility Program. It returns the relevant Government of Canada source, named MAK licensed expert, MAK educational resource, and configured authority, publication, secondary-coverage, and institutional-reference sources where available. Do not use it to decide eligibility, evidence sufficiency, or outcomes.

battle.description: Choose the user source-navigation intent: spousal_pfl = spousal sponsorship, relationship evidence, or spousal-specific procedural fairness letter; business_financial = business immigration, source of funds, or financial evidence; cec_work_evidence = Canadian Experience Class employment or work-experience evidence; express_entry_review = Express Entry file or evidence review; pr_card_residency = in-Canada PR-card renewal and residency-obligation source navigation; bowp_in_canada = BOWP application and status source navigation for workers in Canada; pfl_response = standalone PFL and misrepresentation concerns with the controlling actual IRCC letter; employer_hiring_imp = Canadian employer LMIA-exempt IMP and Employer Portal navigation.
